description: Reviewed inventory for removing Core service ABI and replacing the four supported binding projections with per-language Framework runtimes.

comparisonPolicy.note: Regenerate after reviewing a semantic addition or removal. Documentation prose, source comments, whitespace, file hashes, and timestamps are not compared. A supported binding public service projection is compared as normalized comment-free source so member-level changes cannot bypass review.

bindingProjectionGranularity: top-level public types and enum values are independent records
each public service projection file has a comment-free normalized semantic unit, so any member-level source change requires classification review
every exact Core service symbol reference in a supported binding file is an independent record
bindingStructuralDiscovery: a supported binding public context or factory is included when it declares a service factory member
a supported binding native projection is included when its path or comment-free source contains a service identifier
a supported binding test or sample is included when its path or comment-free source contains a service identifier
an unrelated raw file in the same structural location is not included without a service identifier
scope.broadServiceMarkerDiscovery: Known Core, binding, Framework runtime, CI, and local-package roots are scanned. A marked file without a routing classification is a generation error.

dispositions.target-contract: Application-visible meaning moves to Framework spec, exact interfaces, runtime tests, or E2E before the Core or binding projection is removed.
dispositions.raw-core-prerequisite: The file or capability remains part of the Core 11 raw runtime or the package tooling that proves that raw boundary.
dispositions.superseded: The service-specific mechanism is replaced by language runtime internals and must not become a Framework public API.
dispositions.remove: The classified unit has no Core 11 contract owner. Consult actionDefinitions to determine whether the unit is a whole file, a symbol, or only a fragment in a mixed file.
dispositions.retain-10x-only: The item remains only in the last supported Core 10.x line or read-only archive and is excluded from Core 11 packages and compatibility claims.
dispositions.out-of-scope-v11-service-migration: The item belongs to an independent Framework package such as HTTP client or stream connector and is retained outside the server service-runtime migration lanes.

exclude-from-core-11-build-package-and-c.meaning: Keep the file outside Core 11 artifacts and compatibility claims.

migrate-sample-then-remove-service-refer.meaning: Migrate the service use, then remove only that use from the sample.

migrate-test-then-remove-service-referen.meaning: Migrate the covered behavior, then remove only the service-dependent test fragment.

preserve-meaning-in-target-document-not-.meaning: The historical file does not return; its meaning is owned by the target document.

remove-after-oracle-baseline-sealed.meaning: Remove the active legacy performance input after its baseline is sealed.

remove-binding-service-declaration-after.meaning: Remove this binding public declaration after the Framework replacement exists.

remove-binding-service-projection.meaning: Remove this exact Core service symbol reference from the binding.

remove-binding-service-projection-after-.meaning: Remove the binding service projection file after the Framework replacement exists.

remove-core-service-header-copy-before-c.meaning: Remove only the service-header copy operation from the package script.

remove-core-service-only-document-after-.meaning: Remove the Core-only service document after Framework owns its contract.

remove-export-from-core-11.meaning: Remove this exact export symbol from Core 11.

remove-file.meaning: Remove the complete file at the stated gate.

remove-service-build-reference.meaning: Remove only the service build entry from the mixed build file.

remove-service-projection.meaning: Remove only the binding service projection from the mixed file.

remove-service-reference.meaning: Remove only the classified service reference from the mixed file.

remove-spot-envelope-from-core-zmp-guide.meaning: Remove the service envelope section while retaining the Core ZMP guide.

remove-symbol-from-core-11.meaning: Remove this exact public Core symbol.

remove-zmp-heartbeat-option-frame-timer-.meaning: Remove only the ZMP heartbeat option, frame, timer, or test fragment from the mixed file.

remove-zmp-heartbeat-option-projection.meaning: Remove only the ZMP heartbeat option projection from the binding file.

replace-binding-service-projection-with-.meaning: Replace the service projection use while retaining unrelated Framework code.

replace-generated-output.meaning: Regenerate or replace the complete generated artifact.

replace-package-payload.meaning: Replace the complete packaged binary payload.

retain-and-exclude-from-server-framework.meaning: Retain the adjacent component unchanged outside this migration.

retain-framework-owned-service-wire-inpu.meaning: Retain this Framework-owned service wire input.

retain-generic-scheduler-regression-and-.meaning: Retain the generic test and remove only service assertions.

retain-or-rename-generic-scheduler-and-r.meaning: Retain the generic scheduler and remove only service state.

retain-pgm-heartbeat-spm-as-independent-.meaning: Retain the independent PGM transport heartbeat implementation.

retain-read-only-archive.meaning: Retain the file only as a read-only Core 10.x archive.

retain-reviewed-raw-boundary-or-non-serv.meaning: Retain the reviewed raw or unrelated document.

review-binding-package-tooling-before-pa.meaning: Retain the package tool and review it before package execution.

rewrite-as-core-11-raw-only-guide-and-re.meaning: Retain the guide and rewrite only its service-dependent content.

rewrite-as-core-11-raw-only-internals-an.meaning: Retain the internals document and remove only the service design.

rewrite-formal-contract-as-core-11-raw-o.meaning: Retain the formal document and replace only its service contract.

verify-and-remove-service-package-refere.meaning: Retain the package or CI input and remove only the service reference.
